text: {"table": {"name": "foreign_data", "purpose": "Localized (non-English) text for Magic: The Gathering card printings: one row per card printing per foreign language, holding the translated name, rules text, type line, and flavor text, linked to the card record via a UUID."}, "columns": {"col_001": {"role": "identifier", "name": "id", "description": "Primary key; sequential integer identifier for each foreign-language card entry.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_002": {"role": "free_text", "name": "flavor_text", "description": "Flavor text of the card in the row's language; empty string when the card has no flavor text.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_003": {"role": "category", "name": "language", "description": "Name of the language of this translation (e.g. Japanese, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), Ancient Greek, Sanskrit, Latin, Hebrew).", "status": "resolved"}, "col_004": {"role": "identifier", "name": "multiverse_id", "description": "Numeric identifier of this foreign printing in the Gatherer database; null for printings not indexed there. The exact system is not verifiable from this table alone, but the value pattern matches Gatherer multiverse IDs.", "status": "tentative"}, "col_005": {"role": "free_text", "name": "name", "description": "Card name translated into the row's language (e.g. 'Pacifismo' = Pacifism, 'Zyklop vom Blutfelsen' = Bloodfell Caves Cyclops).", "status": "resolved"}, "col_006": {"role": "free_text", "name": "rules_text", "description": "Rules/rules-box text of the card in the row's language; empty string for cards with no rules text.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_007": {"role": "category", "name": "type_line", "description": "Card type line in the row's language (e.g. 'Kreatur — Zyklop' = Creature — Cyclop); empty when unavailable.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_008": {"role": "foreign_key", "name": "card_uuid", "description": "UUID of the card printing this translation belongs to; references cards.col_072.", "status": "resolved"}}}
